arguments.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_type='BASE TABLE') AS actual_tables, (SELECT count(DISTINCT table_name) FROM public.schema_tables_registry WHERE engine='postgresql' AND schema_name='public' AND is_active=true) AS registered_tables, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.schema_registry_reconciliation_live WHERE object_kind='table' AND registry_status='missing') AS missing_tables, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.schema_registry_reconciliation_live WHERE object_kind='column' AND registry_status='missing') AS missing_columns, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.autsys_project_registry) AS projects, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.autsys_project_components) AS components, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.autsys_release_registry) AS releases, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.autsys_external_capabilities_registry) AS external_capabilities, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.autsys_capabilities_unified) AS unified_capabilities, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.schema_migrations_registry WHERE migration_key IN ('20260916_AUTSYS_CENTRAL_CATALOG_V1','20260916_AUTSYS_SCHEMA_REGISTRY_FULL_SYNC_V1','20260916_AUTSYS_CAPABILITY_VIEW_SECURITY_INVOKER_V1') AND migration_status='applied') AS applied_migrations, (SELECT NOT rolcanlogin FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='autsys_pc_bridge_migrator') AS migrator_disabled;
